<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex19062023-07-2412-59" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon">
            <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (16a5–16a7)"/>
         <lg><l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7172">bdag</rs> gis brjed byang 'di bris pas ||</l> 
         <l>mtha' yas sems can ma lus kun || </l>
         <l>lta bas rmongs par ma gyur cing || </l>
         <l><lb n="16a6"/> spyod pa shin tu dag 'gyur te || </l>
         <l>gol ba'i lam du mi 'gyur zhing || </l>
         <l>'og myin gnas su 'gro bar shog ||</l></lg> || 
         <lg><l>|| <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7172">bdag</rs> kyang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma</rs>'i bka' drin gyis || </l>
         <l>sa rab dga' ba thob bar du || </l>
         <l>stong dang snying rje brtan pa dang ||</l>
         <l><lb n="16a7"/> bdag dang gzhan du brje bar shog ||</l></lg> || 
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4605">bden chung gi 'bum</rs> | rdzogs s+ho || | | rdzogs s+ho | |</seg></TEI>
